name: brooksby-ops
description: Solopreneur OS — config-driven agents for solo consultants running their business in Notion, Gmail, Calendar, and Granola. Onboarding, daily check-in, meeting prep and capture, Monday planner, Friday wrap, the Daybook snapshot, and a full content engine: synthesis, drafting, polish-and-score, publishing and metrics sync. Plus build-voice, which builds a voice profile from dictated samples one register at a time. Optional hooks wire in a local markdown vault.
